PathRef.x-pathSemantics: absolute host-local path; provider resolves symlinks and binds canonical device/inode identity before resource derivation

ExistingLocalIdentity.x-validation: identity must already exist in the authoritative local account database

canonical_parameters_cbor.x-validation: decode canonical CBOR, require a closed object valid against operation_id inputSchema, and reject shell/BLACK operations

time_range.x-validation: from_ms <= to_ms and range <= configured log_time_range_ms

ValidatedHost.x-validation: parse as DNS hostname, IPv4, or IPv6 and reject ports, schemes, paths, credentials, and control characters

MimeType.x-mimeSemantics: lowercased registered or vendor media type without parameters

Revision.x-revisionSemantics: exact monotonic provider revision; compare for equality before mutation

NotificationAction.x-callbackSemantics: authenticated local event re-entering policy; never direct provider execution

start_time.x-timeSemantics: provider-normalized process start time in milliseconds since Unix epoch

PathIdentityDigest.x-digestSemantics: lowercase SHA-256 of canonical path identity tuple (device,inode,type,owner)

BoundedUnixMode.x-modeSemantics: octal permission bits only; no symbolic mode, ACL, file type, or special textual syntax
